capabilities: Run autonomous, stoppable research loops over vault notes
Add bounded file or folder context with @ mentions and the + control
Build AI-discovered MOC indexes with resumable checkpointed runs
Install and select instruction-only skill packages via /skill
Analyze public YouTube videos through Gemini
disambiguation: Not a web or academic research tool; it researches the user's own vault notes.
extras: The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' The development repository is private; only the product repository is public, and the README lists untested areas such as mobile SecretStorage, long MOC runs, and MCP server compatibility.
motivation: The author built it around the boundary that the agent should read what it needs rather than receive the whole vault by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, and asking AI about a vault usually means pasting large amounts of notes into the model instead of letting the agent read only what it needs.

relations.evidence: Supports user-entered Gemini and Agnes API keys stored in Obsidian SecretStorage.
Agnes receives the URL as text because its current adapter does not claim native video input.

summary: Mobile-first AI research agent that searches the vault with bounded context, shows its protected prompt, and requires approval before any note edits.
